name: Level_1 - Task_2
description: Cool the supplied molten sodium silicate from 4000 K to 300 K. Use the supplied BKS-type Buckingham–Coulomb potential with PPPM electrostatics in LAMMPS, with real units, charge atom style, periodic boundaries, and isotropic NPT at zero target pressure. Cool continuously at 10 K/ps. Keep the same atoms and velocities throughout the run. Choose suitable simulation and sampling settings. Save the cooled state, the input and log files, and a time-resolved record of elapsed time, target temperature, measured temperature, pressure, and density.
submission_format: Submit the path to one JSON manifest inside the task workspace. Fill the fields used by this task and link the saved data, settings, and scripts needed to check them. The shared blank manifest also has fields for later Level 2 work; leave those fields empty. Paths may be relative to the manifest.
